§6QMD Basic Processor§f

§aThe root of every processor chain. Start here.§f

The Basic Processor is assembled in an NC Assembler from N-Type Doped Silicon, 4 Redstone, a Gold Ingot, and a Silver Ingot. Simple recipe, massive impact.

This chip goes into LINAC Controllers, Target Chamber Controllers, Beam Meters, Silicon Trackers, Computer Ports, and Advanced Processors. Every QMD machine needs a processor, and this is where it starts.

N-Type Doped Silicon comes from your Fission Irradiator chain. Gold and Silver are standard ores. Redstone is Redstone.

§ePS:§f You will burn through these fast. Set up automated production in the NC Assembler and keep the N-Type Silicon flowing.
